_comment: Per-client config — copy to client.json (gitignored), one per company. The workflow is capability-based: declare which PROVIDER each capability uses and it adapts. One company = one config = one Claude workspace = one tracker. Source at run time: CLIENT_CONFIG_JSON env secret, else client.json.

email._domains_note: Only mail to/from these domains counts as THIS company — keeps a shared/aggregated inbox scoped to one business. Leave [] to include everything in the connected inbox.

execution._note: Triage always runs. 'enabled' lets AI prepare the AI-doable slices (drafts, staged updates). 'autoSend' OFF by default.
